name: Tuft the Full-Ruff Cat
blurb: Tuft, a long-haired brown tabby with a thick, full coat and a big fluffy neck ruff, gets brushed every morning on the sunny garden wall.

name: Parcel the Amber-and-White Cat
blurb: Parcel, a sturdy amber-and-white shorthair with a white chest and white paws, waits by the garden gate each week for the delivery box.

name: Dewpaw the Soft-Cream Cat
blurb: Dewpaw, a sleek, soft-coated cream cat with pale fawn points and calm blue eyes, starts each day with a slow stretch beside the pond.
